comparators: The corresponding unadapted expert and the strongest validation-selected rate-zero expert.
evidence_status: Development only on already exposed dates; supervised delayed-feedback adaptation, not reinforcement learning.
hypothesis: Fast changes in movement incidence may be handled by small online calibration updates while keeping the trained predictive model fixed.
primary_metric: Unchanged balanced accuracy using original model training priors; ordinary accuracy and natural log loss secondary.
reserved: The twenty planned noon confirmation dates remain unopened.
selection: Select base expert and learning rate on validation balanced accuracy, with natural log loss as tiebreak. Assess on the next development date with causal feedback only.
state: Reset offsets to zero at the start of each validation or assessment session. No carry from assessment to validation.
timing: Use actual future_event_time from the canonical immutable feature records. A label cannot update any prediction earlier than that quote arrival.
update: At each decision, decay the three logit offsets toward zero, then apply natural cross-entropy gradients from earlier predictions whose actual future quote has arrived. Each earlier label is consumed once. Use the stored prediction from its original decision for the delayed gradient.
